recipe.visualDefinition: A multi-layered collage featuring a central portrait of a young man and woman framed by a multi-colored rounded rectangle, surrounded by smaller action figures of dancers and motorcyclists against a solid black background.
coreVisualRelationships: Central romantic duo as the primary focal point
Nested concentric rounded frames creating depth
Dynamic peripheral figures breaking the frame boundaries
High-contrast relationship between dark background and vibrant neon borders

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large central portrait occupies the upper-middle section; smaller figures cluster at the bottom and sides.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central couple's faces and the thick purple/pink outer frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top title area, moves down to the central couple, then radiates outward to the dancing figures at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive solid black space surrounding the central graphic element.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation neon frame colors against a low-value black backdrop.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy, rounded sans-serif with irregular baseline
letterConstructionRules: Variable stroke width with rounded terminals
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are shaped to fit within a specific graphic container
The 'G' and 'E' have exaggerated curves to match the silhouette
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between a highly expressive, custom-illustrated title and a rigid, widely-spaced geometric sans-serif for technical info.

preserve: Wide letter spacing for top text
Rounded, bubbly nature of the main title
avoid: Thin strokes for the main title

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the rounded, inflated look of the main title.
Appropriate for the widely spaced geometric metadata at the top.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a collage on a black background. In the center, a portrait of a 1950s-styled teenage couple (boy in grey sweatshirt, girl in pink jacket). Surround them with a thick magenta rounded-corner frame, with thin yellow and orange inner borders. At the bottom, add small cut-out style figures of dancers in 50s attire and motorcycles.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, bubbly, white custom-lettered title at the top center inside a pink motorcycle silhouette. Add a single line of widely spaced, small white geometric sans-serif text across the very top edge.

verificationChecks: Are the frames rounded at the corners?
Is the top text widely tracked?
Is the main title bubbly and white?

adjustableVariables: Density of the dancer figures at the bottom
Specific colors of the neon borders
Tracking width of the top metadata

mustAchieve: Clean, sharp edges on the graphic frames
High contrast between neon and black

postGenerationChecks: Check for concentricity of the rounded frames
Ensure the dancers appear as a collage, not a single scene
Verify the title is centered above the frame
Confirm the top text is perfectly horizontal
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a central portrait with concentric neon rounded frames on a black field, accented by a peripheral collage of action figures and a top-aligned wide-tracked sans-serif header.
